source.coordinateConvention: Grid phase is measured in texel-center coordinates: first pixel center is0. For canonical texture coordinates u,v in[0,1], x=u*width-.5 and y=v*height-.5. A grid boundary occurs at phase+k*step.

frame162.nativePixelCenterMapping: For source pixel index X,Y, design coordinates are[(X+.5)/4,(Y+.5)/4]. Apply inverse homography, then add.5 to normalized coordinates to obtain texture u,v.

description: One reusable logical-pixel artwork model. Robust RGB planes remove stochastic variation within canonical cells;4-pixel boundary bands and alpha stay unchanged. Cell planes are derived only from the reused native master, with no target frame residual.
